title: Moss (YC F25) Is Hiring
summary: Moss, a startup in Y Combinator's Winter 2025 batch (F25), is actively recruiting a Software Engineer to focus on SDK development. This is a standard YC job board posting seeking talent for building developer-facing tools and libraries.
problem_solved: YC-backed Moss is hiring SDK engineering talent to build and maintain their software development kit for external developers.
why_valuable: Joining a YC F25 company early offers potential equity upside and the opportunity to shape foundational developer tools from the ground up.
